# RC3 independent whole-release review — accepted prepared RC scope

This is the fresh L-65 review by `/root/rc3_whole_release_audit`, model `gpt-6-astra`, reviewer session `01a17c0e-359c-7122-8cc2-a7a2a8ccd185`, reviewer turn `01a17c0e-35d1-72a1-aa21-11257deb29c9`. The author and reviewer sessions differ. The actual `fork_turns: none` spawn and selected model/session metadata were independently checked at their original record ordinals and hashes. Only selected metadata is retained; no full transcript or hidden reasoning was copied. This reviewer has not authored or edited the implementation, gates or repository workflows.

**Accepted as the independent review of the prepared RC3, with the nonblocking findings and scope below.** Exact reviewed commit is `9c5c0916412d2e398a96513daa9fd9d2966023db`, tree `56db0b08dcc392fefbf939c0b4f9c762d908476b`. The complete 5,010-blob manifest SHA-256 is `6f27c65f072a5f1871845d31c936b80e697c9e67eb4e9a7cd05f2415d9fa12a2`. Independently reviewed final delta SHA-256 `07274e91fe9b404d413395a29b2c065e4ae3d3c2da48636c877e0e9a7e2554a2` changes only two evidence/gate files. Product, harness, workflow and versions remain those measured at `34277d43ef3fab40282d659a1f97523594db56c7` / tree `57294b7115b9f5c1c720edefef86f60edf6eb597`; none of those executions or archive bytes is relabeled as 9c5c. All non-audit RC contract rows are complete with actual evidence, and the audit row is pending in the reviewed input. Existing RC2 D14 records are historical inputs only.

## Requirement basis

`requirement-inputs.json` authenticates the read sources. The delivered original Forma Stack v2 `design.md` is byte-identical to `tasks/forma-stack/design.md` at tag `task/forma-stack/v2`, commit `dd0856194ae29136d4eb93e967a88bd1953f7b5b`; SHA-256 `2c46413de76244007aba035bd839687c8016c37645b07f7cde2dace44fdd1b0a`. The similarly named FORM language specification is not used. The accepted decision brief, V2 coverage map and current release dispositions are distinct from original target text.

The review has read original G6/R17/N7, SR2/SR13/SR14/SR17/SR33 and release/validation obligations, current accepted L-50/L-57/L-60/L-61/L-62/L-64/L-65/L-66/L-67 boundaries, current RC burn-in/qualification procedures and RC3 preparation/gate state. N7 remains 20 complete normal commands, rank-19 p95 strictly below 600 seconds; the donor review changes no performance requirement. SR33's accepted content-dependent cost and per-event-budget residuals remain explicit; a cost-removal control is not an unconditional hostile-task 50 ms guarantee. L-65 changes reviewer initialization only. The historical 3.0 post-final soak scheduling exception does not transfer to 3.2.

All 49 frozen research-file hashes, 105 question IDs and 57 acceptance IDs were verified through the inspected read-only research checker. The research/design/implementation ledger distinguishes source inspection, prototype evidence, source tests, installed products and real browser behavior. All 49 referenced acceptance-evidence files were rehashed independently, and the current 57-row acceptance ID inventory matches the research/design ID inventory. The original feature and RC2 row narratives retain their own producer identities; none becomes an RC3 execution merely by being referenced here. Actual Mac user confirmation remains that broad original confirmation, without invented speech transcripts. Physical iPhone HTTPS, deployed site/direct-route/proxy/rollback and same-line soak remain later obligations.

## Evidence independently reviewed so far

| Evidence | Independent check and bounded conclusion |
|---|---|
| N7 measurement donor | Full source/policy review and 68 independent static checks. Final donor `448fd57bcac9b23ccc990cc1340238ee363a5b18` / tree `43e2faafb6d724faef6c6f9d557c0f1ff25d9214` verified locally and against GitHub; only CI workflow differs and exact reviewed SHA-256 is `10db9d34c7a8c5e2afe7383afe318f05430023e5b1867acccbde6a0211c14a51`. Final identity condition resolved in its separate receipt. All20 original attempt 1 results are now reviewed: commands and both pipeline statuses succeed, p95 748.73s/max760.10s fails N7; full evidence is retained. |
| Source CI | Original run 40460309193 attempt 1 succeeds: 19 executed jobs and one intentional unpublished-registry scaffold skip. Security 40460309075, scaffold cache 40460308951 and budgets 40460309137 succeed. Independently parsed all 25 original executed job logs; every checkout is synthetic merge `2a05f0929c6719ddcafda087166a1fb531ec2478`, whose provider parents and tree exactly bind RC2 base plus current RC3 source. Ordinary R17's 651-second success is one observation, not N7 conformity. Burn-in setup earns zero active-soak credit. |

Each of six intended source weakenings matches its original mutant hash and fails the named assertion with exit 101; all six before and six corrected controls pass with exit 0. All 169 security-tagged probes caught. The actual `src/expr/` subset is 98/98, independently replaying its 85% floor. Survivors `list/small-threshold-1` and `list/small-threshold-huge` remain survivors. Current core source/test/corpus/classifier/workflow/external dependencies are unchanged; four changed declared paths are internal version leaves and README/changelog. This is applicability of original evidence, not a new RC3 campaign or universal router/server mutation proof. |

Independent replay checks 3,518 file hashes, 11 ZIP members and 543 package archive members. Original raw outcomes contain 90 unique passed cases, 30 per engine; 69 retained, 15 replaced and three refusal-control document observations retain actual identities. Live provider run/artifact metadata and RC2 predecessor asset authenticate; all 214 original ZIP members match retained files. Separate reviewer code reconstructs actual guard and Array.from mutation bytes, exact source hashes, all 2,082 hostile cases and 30 capability outcomes. Guard fails for a real selector/none outside-root read; expression mutant fails case 37 (actual cost 0, independent floor 42), while before/corrected each complete 100,000 cases. Unknown versions/stubs, unbound sources/runs, changed bytes and duplicate inventory claims remain outside this plan. This source cannot itself create the future receipt or a passing live inventory. |

## Final decision and retained findings

The current N7 campaign is complete and fails its unchanged strict wall-time target. The full ordered 20-vector is:

`612.02, 730.86, 733.56, 748.73, 561.09, 743.69, 760.10, 510.74, 733.70, 538.05, 738.33, 727.24, 575.01, 728.61, 726.40, 738.50, 741.18, 734.40, 601.35, 562.57` seconds.

Rank 19 p95 is **748.73s**, maximum **760.10s**; 15/20 exceed 600 s. All twenty complete normal commands, including npm ci, and all command/tee statuses succeed. All 80 original API-digest-authenticated artifacts, full original attempt logs, runner/cache/toolchain observations and indexed vectors remain preserved. Every indexed all 101 mean/scaling guard passes independently; small-mean p95/max 0.00136347100286204/0.0013753154490255156ms, large-mean 0.001368018424156883/0.0013779139754794174ms, ratio 1.0162541367900404/1.016955338774882. No pooling, weighting, no-op subtraction, selection, replacement or rerun occurred.

I independently classify this as a **medium, nonblocking finding for the prepared prerelease audit**, based on its demonstrated effect on maintainer feedback and CI cost while all functional commands and packed/security/product checks succeed. This is not a timing waiver or a claim that N7 is met. It does not approve stable release or establish a cause from the observed CPU/cache variation. The full product acceptance target remains unmet. The old RC2 classification did not determine this outcome.

All original finding IDs/severities are retained with current reassessment:

- **D14-3.2-001 — medium, resolved.** Historical recovery defect remains resolved. Current source sets irreversible before owner commit, detaches the failed session before cleanup/recovery, and fences reentrant generation/mutation authority. Original recovery controls retain their original identities; current unchanged product source and fresh packed native/P17 proof support applicability without relabeling the older controls.
- **D14-3.2-002 — low, resolved.** Current documentation accurately distinguishes stable 3.1, published RC2 and unpublished prepared RC3, eight packages and three starters, original failed publication/qualification observations, and later required gates. The 57 historical row dispositions and their 49 evidence files retain original identities. The two-file final closure delta was independently read against current receipts and changes no product, harness or version inputs.
- **D14-3.2-003 — low, resolved.** The previously repaired native-router advisory coverage remains in the current version-selected inventory. Current source CI and fresh packed P17 cover all shipped crate locks and all three starters. No uncovered present vulnerability is inferred from the earlier coverage defect.
- **D14-3.2-004 — medium, resolved.** The previously repaired consumer workflows remain scripts-off with complete npm installation, registry signatures/full advisories and pinned cargo-deny/live advisory fetch. Current original packed templates match checked-in sources and all three starter P17 paths pass. This retains the historical repair, rather than treating old workflow controls as newly executed.
- **D14-3.2-005 — medium, nonblocking.** The broader historical bootstrap credential remains a disclosed founder-authorized finite exception, with the original removal/token-absence/trust-policy observations retained. RC3 requires ordinary trusted publication and authorizes no new bootstrap credential. The current record accurately reports actual RC2 OIDC observation and explicitly does not claim independent attestation signature-chain verification. This historical governance residual is not erased or described as least privilege.
- **D14-3.2-006 — medium, resolved.** The held-POP click repair remains in source: raw href is resolved through the committed-view eligibility path, and a missing href stays native. Original failed/corrected three-engine and complete history evidence retains its original source. Current router runtime is byte-identical to the authenticated prior product and the fresh packed navigation proof passes.
- **D14-3.2-007 — low, resolved.** The scroll-bound repair remains immediately after current-entry assignment and before value/title callbacks: insert current key, then prune to 1000. Original failure/corrected controls and actual installed receipts remain retained; no cap is raised and no later callback can precede this bookkeeping.
- **D14-3.2-008 — medium, resolved.** Five-package observer defaults and eight-package registry inventory remain prepared before freeze. Current RC3 adds only the finite authenticated router holding-artifact path, with unknown stubs/changed bytes/duplicate claims refused. Full live SR2 remains failed: future RC3 recording can account for router 0.0.0-stage only; inherited forma-ir-derive 0.0.0 remains FORMA-224. Configuration and source tests do not stand in for live success.
- **D14-3.2-009 — low, nonblocking.** The repeated visible/live-region unknown-outcome warning remains a low-severity wording defect. Source still appends the warning to an already-warning announcement. Original one-send/uncertainty/refusal evidence is retained, current form/native controls pass, and no new speech result or runtime fix is claimed. This does not compromise the preserved no-automatic-retry safety behavior.
- **D14-3.2-010 — high, resolved.** High historical RC1 record failure severity is preserved. The committed exact-version changelog preflight/shared parser repair remains in source, RC3 has its actual heading, and current source/release control tests pass. RC1 remains a failed immutable workflow with inventory-only recovery. Actual RC2 recording subsequently succeeded; prospective RC3 recording is still a future outcome.
- **D14-3.2-011 — medium, resolved.** The historical opaque-proof validation defect remains resolved through the shared semantic validator before recovered claims are admitted. This reviewer independently replayed the retained original recovery evidence and current field/cause checks. Current placeholder accounting separately authenticates canonical preparation bytes, actual host/check/record executions and the exact plan; it cannot promote RC1 or the holding archive to qualification.
- **D14-3.2-012 — medium, nonblocking.** Current N7 is a measured maintainability target miss, no longer merely an evidence gap: all twenty complete normal commands/tee exits succeed, but rank-19 p95 is 748.73 seconds and maximum 760.10 against strict p95 <600. All original samples/artifacts and per-run indexed vectors remain; indexed acceptance passes in all twenty. Severity medium reflects slower maintainer feedback and CI cost, with no observed functional/security or publication-integrity failure. Independently classified nonblocking for this prepared prerelease audit only. N7 remains unmet; this does not waive its requirement, permit retry-to-green, claim stable conformance, or infer a CPU/cache cause. Stable acceptance remains open.
- **D14-RC3-001 — info, resolved.** Prospective donor review and final local/remote Git identity were verified before the single authorized dispatch. Original all 20 attempt 1 evidence is now complete. This closes the collection/identity condition only; the failed timing requirement remains D14-3.2-012.
- **D14-RC3-002 — info, resolved.** Actual current dry-pack P17 run 40460337225/attempt 1 and all 214 original ZIP members independently authenticate:75/75 in 1,364.505 s. Full raw measurement/current validator replay and independent guard/cost-mutation byte/cause checks pass against real published RC2 predecessor DS12 e17542c6. No historical P17 is relabeled and tagged qualification remains required.
- **D14-RC3-003 — info, resolved.** Final exact review input 9c5c0916412d2e398a96513daa9fd9d2966023db / tree 56db0b08dcc392fefbf939c0b4f9c762d908476b has a complete 5,010-blob manifest. The only delta from measured 342 is additive preparation documentation and actual documentation/candidate gate closure; audit remains pending at the reviewed tree. All non-audit RC gates are done with actual evidence; final/device/site/soak gates remain separate.
- **D14-RC3-004 — medium, nonblocking.** The full registry reconciliation residual remains explicit. The closed router holding-archive plan is inventory-only and prospective until successful actual RC3 recording and reconciliation. Inherited forma-ir-derive0.0.0 remains FORMA-224 without any exemption or clean-SR2 claim. This preserved accounting backlog is nonblocking for this prepared RC audit, not a declaration of SR2 conformity.
- **D14-RC3-005 — low, resolved.** The wrong-source native preflight refusal followed by unintended helper execution/interruption remains preserved as an invalid operational attempt, with no qualification credit and no claimed product regression. Separate verified-source final native 90/90 and size evidence authenticate original archives, installed files and cleanup. The corrected operational evidence resolves the current input ambiguity without erasing history.
- **D14-RC3-006 — info, nonblocking.** Normal R17 security reports all retain sourceClean=false after preceding check stages; no dirty-path inventory exists, so its contents are not invented. Actual source/runtime/harness/worker/engine hashes and intended mutant causes independently match current authenticated product evidence. These observations prove original command scope, not clean-source P17. The separate packed-P17 security evidence supplies the stronger release qualification.

RC2's original valid failed N1 attempt, successful second P17 attempt and 3,504.467-second outer release-clock miss remain historical facts. A new P17 duration does not reset or replace that outer clock. Stable 3.1 remains the released stable line. RC3 tagging, exact-main/tag checks, trusted publication/recording and later stable/device/site/soak work are not credited by this prepared-RC review.

Reviewer read-only setup errors are separately retained: initial native-comparison schema mismatch, absent local synthetic Git object (resolved through authenticated provider tree equality), a checkout-log parser that initially missed quoted Windows `git.exe` paths, and an incorrect hardcoded hostile-case count corrected by deriving the full expected IDs from the authenticated current catalogue. Their corrections changed observer interpretation only; no producer data or implementation was changed, and no benchmark/browser/build was rerun.


## Acceptance boundary and evidence

No blocking source/product/publication-integrity finding remains for this prepared RC scope. This acceptance permits completion of the D14 audit row through the existing audited-input binding rules; it does not perform a merge, tag, publication, registry exemption or stable acceptance. After this reviewed tree, only exact audit-status completion, the actual audit records and independently reviewed documentation/changelog changes are permitted. Changed product/harness/version bytes require renewed review and evidence.

The final preparation document's N7-pending sentence is a dated checkpoint; the actual result above supersedes uncertainty without rewriting that historical snapshot. Subsequent current documentation must state the measured miss. Stable 3.1 remains stable, RC2 remains the actual published prerelease, and RC3 remains unpublished at review. Physical iPhone HTTPS, actual OVH/site/proxy/direct-route/rollback, same-line 3,600 active-second fault-free soak, immutable-tag/main qualification and successful trusted publication/DS12 all retain their own obligations. This review does not supply any of them.

Independent outputs in this folder: requirement-inputs.json; session-projection-verification.json; n7-static-review.json; n7-donor-final-identity-review.json; retained-evidence-review.json; mutation-source-applicability.json; expression-floor-independent-review.json; native-size-independent-verification.json; source-planes-independent-verification.json; security-probes-independent-verification.json; p17-original-independent-verification.json; p17-validator-replay.json; final-input-applicability.json. N7 original data and actual classification are under ../../hosted-34277d43/n7-run-40462310769/{final-collection.json,independent-review.json,original-provider-log-authentication.json,SUMMARY.md,evidence-index.json}. The compact supporting-evidence-index.json authenticates these exact observer receipts; original provider ZIPs/raw reports remain retained at their described locations.

No local browser, Cargo build, benchmark, performance measurement, workflow rerun, product edit or gate edit was performed by this reviewer. Read-only arithmetic/semantic replay is distinguished from execution. Initial observer assumptions/errors and corrections are preserved, including the N7 comma timestamp and inappropriate P17 clean-source predicate. All ordinary R17 reports still say sourceClean=false, whose dirty paths were not emitted; exact relevant source/runtime hashes authenticate without inventing a clean checkout during those stages. The separate clean packed P17 remains the release-security evidence.

I, /root/rc3_whole_release_audit, using actual gpt-6-astra (ultra), reviewer session 01a17c0e-359c-7122-8cc2-a7a2a8ccd185 and turn 01a17c0e-35d1-72a1-aa21-11257deb29c9, independently reviewed exact commit 9c5c0916412d2e398a96513daa9fd9d2966023db / tree 56db0b08dcc392fefbf939c0b4f9c762d908476b against the original frozen Forma Stack v2 specification, accepted decisions, research/design 57-row ledger, current source, actual retained mutation and SR14/SR17/SR33 evidence, all eight actual RC3 dry-packed archives, native/paired-size proof, original current CI/P17, and all twenty original N7 observations. Separate actual author/reviewer sessions and fork_turns=none initialization were verified from selected original metadata records.

The supporting review preserves all findings, limitations and failed/interrupted history. No blocking finding remains for this prepared prerelease audit. N7 is explicitly NOT met: all commands pass but p95 is 748.73 seconds, maximum 760.10 against strict p95 <600. I independently classify that maintainability miss medium/nonblocking at RC scope only; no timing waiver, causal CPU/cache claim or stable approval is issued. Full SR2 remains failed with the two inventory residuals; only router's exact holding artifact may receive a future finite inventory receipt, while FORMA-224 remains open without exemption. Repeated unknown-outcome wording remains a low-severity observation. The stronger clean-source release-security proof comes from separate original current P17; ordinary R17's dirty flags are preserved.

This accepts the actual independent review, not every original target or future release outcome. Product/harness/version bytes after this input require renewed review. Exact-main/tag qualification, trusted publication/recording, actual site/device acceptance, same-line 3,600 active-second soak and stable acceptance remain required.
